traits.zh: 椰青美式清爽顺口，椰青甜润中和美式苦味
traits.en: Coconut Americano is refreshing and smooth, with coconut sweetness balancing espresso bitterness

traits.zh: 设有室外座位区，配透明防雨罩
traits.en: Outdoor seating area with transparent rain cover

traits.zh: 小型店铺，以吧台式操作区为主
traits.en: Small shop centered around a bar-style service counter

traits.zh: 室内光线主要来自人工照明，无明显自然光
traits.en: Interior lighting is primarily artificial, with no significant natural light

linger.zh: 小型吧台店，非久坐导向
linger.en: Bar-style small shop, not designed for long stays

adventure.zh: 使用椰青制作美式，非经典配方
adventure.en: Coconut Americano deviates from classic preparation
